justification: Citi Bike's captured plan text lists an annual membership at $239/year with 45-minute classic rides.
The captured pricing text lists a single classic ride at $4.99 for 30 minutes and $0.41/minute afterward.
The uploaded period has 520 trips across 4745 days; pay-per-ride totals $2594.80.
Membership plus residual overage totals $3107.00; the simple annual break-even is 48 short rides.
Decision: Pay Per Ride/Minute. This is a price-only comparison; it assumes classic bikes and uses the observed date span as the membership renewal period.

inputs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count, ROUND(AVG(duration_minutes), 2) AS average_minutes FROM trips

timeline.rationale: Measure the uploaded trip volume and average duration.
